_comment: Placeholder encounters, resolved by scripts/systems/combat_resolver.gd. strength/toll/loot are [min, max] and scale up gently with the day count.

encounters.name: Pirate Sloop
encounters.text: A black-sailed sloop cuts across your bow. Its captain grins and raises a cutlass.

encounters.name: Sea Serpent
encounters.text: The water boils. A scaled neck rises higher than your mast, eyeing your cargo hungrily.

encounters.name: Smuggler Cutter
encounters.text: A fast cutter flying no colours pulls alongside. They demand a 'fee' for safe passage.

encounters.name: Reef Wreckers
encounters.text: False lanterns on the rocks! Longboats full of wreckers row out of the dark.
